title: Not Quite The Anticipated Quality
text: Not Quite The Anticipated Quality. I would have expected better quality from Mikasa. The vase is nice and thick, like hand-blown glass. The color is more of a milk glass. The finish is just sloppy looking. There are small bubbles in the finish, not nice looking ones, but kind of frothy looking. The finish isn't perfect and smooth. I would expect some variation, but this just looks bad. I have much cheaper vases that look much nicer than this one. Mine is 10" tall, so there seems to be some minor variation on actual size. Also, the picture looks like the top is slanted and mine is completely flat/even.
